description: This file defines a TypeScript declaration for the Long class and associated types used for 64-bit integer operations, including constructors, static constants, and various arithmetic and bitwise methods.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class representing 64-bit two's complement integers with various static methods for creation and instance methods for arithmetic, bitwise operations, and conversions.

methods.name: constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean); constructor
methods.description: Constructs a 64-bit Long from low and optional high bits, with optional unsigned flag.

methods.name: static fromBits
methods.description: Creates a Long from low and high 32-bit parts.

methods.name: static fromInt
methods.description: Creates a Long from a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: static fromNumber
methods.description: Creates a Long from a JavaScript number.

methods.name: static fromBigInt
methods.description: Creates a Long from a BigInt value.

methods.name: static fromString
methods.description: Creates a Long by parsing a string with the specified radix.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns the sum of this Long and the specified Long-like value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this Long equals another Long-like value.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if this Long is less than another Long-like value.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts the Long to a JavaScript number.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the Long to its string representation.

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^  constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean);$/
